skill.displayName: Big8 · 算八字·玄学算命助手（八字排盘·算命·风水·面相·星座·每日一卦）| Chinese Fortune Telling, Feng Shui & BaZi

llm.summary: This skill is mostly coherent, but it asks users to upload face photos for personality-style analysis while making privacy claims that are not clearly scoped to the actual vision-model processing.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is fortune-telling, feng shui, BaZi, zodiac, and face-reading; image and selfie analysis are purpose-aligned, but face photos are sensitive personal data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill routes pure images to a vision model and analyzes selfies by facial features without an explicit pre-analysis consent step or a clear biometric/sensitive-image warning.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains a SKILL.md, one Python helper script, and local YAML knowledge files; there is no installer, package takeover signal, or hidden setup behavior in the inspected files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The plan says face images are not uploaded to any third party, but the same artifact relies on an unspecified Vision Model; unless that model is local, this privacy assurance is under-disclosed or potentially misleading.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The Python script performs local date, astrology, divination, and calendar calculations; no persistence, credential access, background worker, destructive action, or network call was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review before installing if users may upload selfies or other personal photos. The skill should clarify whether image processing is local or handled by a hosted model provider, what happens to uploaded images, and that face-reading results are speculative entertainment rather than factual assessment.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: The concern is supported by artifact text: face images are sent to an unspecified Vision Model while the plan claims no third-party upload. This is not enough for maliciousness, but it is a material disclosure problem for sensitive images.
[SQP-2] expected: Selfie-based face-reading is central to the skill, and SKILL.md does include entertainment and no-storage language, but it lacks a clear biometric/sensitive-data warning and explicit consent before processing.
